issue_context.title: Feature: Add support for pasting items as shortcut
issue_context.body:
### What feature or improvement do you think would benefit Files?

> First improvement: Paste shortcut

In File Explorer, when you copy something, you you have two option to paste it, either "Paste" or "Paste Shortcut" which basically paste but its a shortcut to original file which look something like this:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/13d6b9d5-de2b-4c37-ac16-667d2f218c4a)

So I was wondering if we could add the "Paste Shortcut" option in Files context menu specifically in one of these places:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/882b7303-78bd-4a7f-b966-6d53e8754d45)


### Requirements

1. Add a "Paste shortcut" action
2. Add an option to the Files context menu.

### Files Version

3.7.11.0

### Windows Version

10.0.22631.4317
